description: This file defines the TableCatalog interface for managing table metadata within Spark's data source catalog system, including methods for listing, loading, creating, altering, dropping, purging, and renaming tables, as well as handling table properties and capabilities.

classes.name: TableCatalog
classes.description: Interface for catalog implementations that manage table metadata, supporting operations like listing, loading, creating, altering, dropping, purging, and renaming tables, along with property management and capabilities.

methods.name: listTables
methods.description: Lists table identifiers in a given namespace, may throw NoSuchNamespaceException.

methods.name: listTableSummaries
methods.description: Provides summaries of tables in a namespace, including table type, with default implementation.

methods.name: loadTable
methods.description: Loads table metadata by identifier, throws NoSuchTableException if not found or is a view.

methods.name: loadTable (with writePrivileges)
methods.description: Loads table metadata with specified write privileges, default calls loadTable by identifier.

methods.name: loadTable (with version)
methods.description: Loads table metadata for a specific version, throws error if not found.

methods.name: loadTable (with timestamp)
methods.description: Loads table metadata at a specific timestamp, throws error if not found.

methods.name: invalidateTable
methods.description: Invalidates cached metadata for a table identifier.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a table exists by identifier, returns false if not.

methods.name: createTable (deprecated with schema)
methods.description: Deprecated method to create a table with schema, throws error if not overridden.

methods.name: createTable (deprecated with columns)
methods.description: Deprecated method to create a table with columns, converts columns to schema.

methods.name: createTable (with TableInfo)
methods.description: Creates a table with detailed TableInfo object, default implementation calls other createTable.

methods.name: useNullableQuerySchema
methods.description: Indicates whether to mark all fields as nullable during create/replace table operations.

methods.name: alterTable
methods.description: Applies changes to a table, throws NoSuchTableException if table does not exist.

methods.name: dropTable
methods.description: Drops a table by identifier, returns true if deleted.

methods.name: purgeTable
methods.description: Permanently removes table data, default throws unsupported error.

methods.name: renameTable
methods.description: Renames a table from old to new identifier, throws exceptions if invalid.
